answer.en: Only a small sprinkle of curly parsley, occasionally. The ASPCA lists parsley as toxic to dogs, because large amounts can make the skin sensitive to sunlight. Curly parsley is the safest option; spring parsley can be toxic, and Italian parsley can be toxic in large quantities.
answer.sl: Le majhen ščepec kodrastega peteršilja, občasno. ASPCA peteršilj uvršča med strupene za pse, ker lahko velike količine povzročijo občutljivost kože na sonce. Kodrasti peteršilj je najvarnejša izbira; spomladanski peteršilj je lahko strupen, italijanski pa v velikih količinah.

why.en: Parsley contains furanocoumarins. In large amounts they can cause sensitivity to sunlight and skin inflammation like a sunburn, although large amounts are needed for this effect. Parsley is also a diuretic; Italian parsley can lead to dehydration in dogs with sensitive stomachs. The AKC says curly parsley can be offered in small amounts, while the ASPCA lists parsley as toxic to dogs, so we take the stricter view and rate it not recommended.
why.sl: Peteršilj vsebuje furanokumarine. V velikih količinah lahko povzročijo občutljivost na sončno svetlobo in vnetje kože, podobno sončnim opeklinam, a so za to potrebne velike količine. Peteršilj tudi odvaja vodo; italijanski peteršilj lahko pri psih z občutljivim želodcem povzroči dehidracijo. AKC navaja, da lahko kodrasti peteršilj ponudimo v majhnih količinah, ASPCA pa ga uvršča med strupene za pse, zato se držimo strožje ocene in ga ne priporočamo.

what_to_do.en: If you give your dog parsley, monitor them closely for any unusual symptoms. If symptoms appear or get worse, contact your veterinarian promptly.
what_to_do.sl: Če psu daste peteršilj, ga skrbno opazujte, ali se pojavijo nenavadni znaki. Če se znaki pojavijo ali poslabšajo, se nemudoma obrnite na veterinarja.

serving.en: If at all, only a small sprinkle of curly parsley as a garnish, given occasionally. Never large amounts.
serving.sl: Če sploh, le majhen ščepec kodrastega peteršilja kot okras, občasno. Nikoli velikih količin.

child.en: Parsley is not a dog snack. A grown-up decides if a dog gets a tiny sprinkle of curly parsley.
child.sl: Peteršilj ni pasji prigrizek. Odrasli odloči, ali pes dobi majhen ščepec kodrastega peteršilja.

q.en: Is curly parsley different from other parsley?
q.sl: Se kodrasti peteršilj razlikuje od drugih vrst?

a.en: Yes. Curly parsley is generally considered the safest option. Spring parsley can be toxic, and Italian parsley acts as a diuretic and can be toxic in large quantities.
a.sl: Da. Kodrasti peteršilj velja za najvarnejšo izbiro. Spomladanski peteršilj je lahko strupen, italijanski peteršilj pa odvaja vodo in je v velikih količinah lahko strupen.

q.en: Can parsley make a dog's skin sensitive to the sun?
q.sl: Ali lahko peteršilj naredi pasjo kožo občutljivo na sonce?

a.en: In large amounts, yes. The furanocoumarins in parsley can cause skin inflammation like a sunburn.
a.sl: V velikih količinah da. Furanokumarini v peteršilju lahko povzročijo vnetje kože, podobno sončnim opeklinam.

sources.quote: Toxicity: Toxic to Dogs, Toxic to Cats, Toxic to Horses
Clinical Signs: Photosensitization (sunburn, dermatitis), large amounts are needed to cause this effect
Curly parsley is generally considered the safest option and can be offered in small amounts as a garnish or supplement.
Other varieties, like Italian parsley, act as diuretics, which can lead to dehydration in dogs with sensitive stomachs.
Italian parsley can also be toxic if administered in large quantities.
Furanocoumarins in large amounts can cause dermal inflammation, like a sunburn.
Only a small sprinkle of curly parsley is recommended.
Parsley should only be given occasionally and in small amounts.
If you introduce parsley into your dog’s diet, monitor them closely for any unusual symptoms.
If symptoms appear or worsen, contact your veterinarian promptly.
While curly-leafed parsley is OK, spring parsley can be toxic.
Because parsley is a diuretic, you’ll want to give it to your dog only sparingly.
